attributes.residual: NONE. fndiff --clean reports MATCH, 0 real diff lines (4 pool-name lines suppressed - symbol spelling only, identical after link). The prior record's top axis, multiply operand order, was the right observation read the wrong way round: it is NOT an independent difference to be chased with source spellings, it is a CONSEQUENCE of the recolor. The whole 86-instruction residual is a three-register scratch renaming over nine instructions at +0x24-0x54: the two glow-global webs exchange homes (r6 <-> r8 - ours loads the first into r6 and shifts it, retail into r8, with the roles swapping again at the second load and at the surviving cmpw r29 at +0x54), and the quotient/product temporary moves r9 -> r3. The mullw at +0x3c genuinely exchanges its two commuting factors (ours mullw r0,r9,r0 vs retail mullw r0,r0,r3), and the bisimulation's COMMUTATIVE-OPERAND pairing accepts exactly that under the running renaming. GENERALIZABLE LESSON: when a residual is classified OPERAND_DIFF on a commutative instruction, run the renaming bisimulation before opening a source-shape matrix - the guard already models factor exchange, so an operand swap that is consistent with a register renaming is not a separate defect and costs no extra rule machinery.
